Rashi on Nedarim 38b:1:1.hebrew: נפשה וגופה לשמים - שאינה ראויה לאכילה, לפיכך זן אותה, דאינו מהנהו הנאה מרובה:
Rashi on Nedarim 38b:1:1.english: Its being and its body [belong] to Heaven - For it is not fit for eating; therefore he [may] feed it, since he does not benefit him [with] a great benefit.

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:1:2.english: He sells it to idolaters - And he is pleased with [its] fattening.

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:2:1.english: To the groom - That the groom is the one forbidden by vow.

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:2:2.english: Behold, he provides him a maidservant to serve him - And why is [it] permitted?

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:3:1.hebrew: אלא בשנכסי חתן אסורין אצל אבי הכלה - ואע"פ שהחתן מהנהו שזן את בתו, אפי' הכי משיא לו את בתו. ומשיב הש"ס: משום הא לא צריך למימר דמותר להשיא את בתו:
Rashi on Nedarim 38b:3:1.english: Rather, when the property of the groom is forbidden to the father of the bride - Even though the groom benefits him in that he feeds his daughter, even so he may marry his daughter to him. And the Talmud responds: Because of this, it is not necessary to state that it is permitted to marry his daughter to him.

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:3:2.hebrew: דגדולה מזו אמרו - בשנכסיו אסורים על הנודר אמרנו, וזן את אשתו:
Rashi on Nedarim 38b:3:2.english: For [a law] greater than this they stated - [It was] regarding [one whose] property is forbidden to the vower [that] we stated [this], and he feeds his wife.

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:3:3.hebrew: אע"פ וכו' ואת אמרת וכו' - פשיטא דמותר, דהא לא מהני כלל:
Rashi on Nedarim 38b:3:3.english: Although, etc., and you say, etc. - It is obvious that it is permitted, for he does not benefit [him] at all.

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:4:1.hebrew: לעולם בשנכסי אבי כלה אסורין על החתן - ודקאמרת הרי מוסר לו שפחה לשמשו, תריץ: בבתו בוגרת עסקינן, שיכול להשיאו ומדעת עצמה. דהואיל ואינו משיא אלא מדעת עצמה, לאו הנאה דקא מהני ליה איהו, אלא הנאה מועטת:
Rashi on Nedarim 38b:4:1.english: Actually, [it is a case] where the property of the father of the bride is forbidden to the groom - And [as for] what you asked, "Behold, he is handing over to him a maidservant to serve him," resolve [it thus]: we are dealing with his daughter [who is] a grown woman (bogeret), whom he can marry to him, and [only] with her own consent. For since he only marries [her] off with her own consent, [it is] not a benefit that he [himself] is conferring upon him, rather a minor benefit.

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:5:1.english: That is also taught - That a minor benefit is permitted.

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:6:1.english: One who vows [to prohibit] his son - from his property if he does not study Torah.

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:6:2.hebrew: מותר - האב למלאות כו', שהנאה מרובה נדר הימנו ולא הנאה מועטת, וזו הנאה מועטת היא:
Rashi on Nedarim 38b:6:2.english: It is permitted - [for] the father to fill, etc., for he vowed [to forbid] him major benefit and not minor benefit, and this is a minor benefit.

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:6:3.english: Cup of the bathhouse - It is a minor benefit.

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:7:1.english: [They] are made for labor - [They] are made for the purpose of work, and not to be fattened.

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:7:2.hebrew: למנחרותא - לעבודתו, והואיל וקי"ל יכול הרב לומר לעבד "עשה עמי ואיני זנך", אינה הנאה למודר אם זה מפרנס עבדיו:
Rashi on Nedarim 38b:7:2.english: For labor - For his work; and since we hold that a master can say to a slave, "Work for me, and I will not feed you," it is not a benefit to the one forbidden by the vow if this [other person] feeds his slaves.

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:7:3.english: [An animal] is designated for fattening - For a kosher [animal is] for slaughter, and a non-kosher [animal is] for [sale to] a gentile.

Rashi on Nedarim 38b:8:1.english: One for whom benefit from another is forbidden by vow, [who] enters to visit him, stands but does not sit - As [the Gemara] explains later.

Tosafot on Nedarim 38b:2:1.hebrew: הרי מוסר שפחה לשמשו - דס"ד דאיירי בקטנה שניסת על ידו, ואת אמרת דמותר להשיא בתו — הא פשיטא דאסור:
Tosafot on Nedarim 38b:2:1.english: "He provides a maidservant to serve him" - For [Rabbi Zeira] initially thought that [Rav Huna] is dealing with a minor [daughter] who is married off by him [her father], and [yet] you say that it is permitted to marry off his daughter — [why,] it is obvious that it is forbidden.

Tosafot on Nedarim 38b:4:1.hebrew: בבתו בוגרת דמדעתה - וקמ"ל אף על גב שהוא מדבר עמה ומשיא עצה לה להנשא לו, הנאת דבור לא מקרי הנאה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 38b:4:1.english: Where his daughter is a grown woman, [so] that [it is] with her consent - And [this] teaches us [that] even though he [the father] speaks with her and advises her to marry him, the benefit of speech is not considered benefit.
